title: Lacson disputes Sara Duterte’s claim that corruption runs in gov’t ‘DNA’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senator Panfilo Lacson on Friday disputed Vice President Sara Duterte’s remark that corruption is a “progressive disorder” deeply embedded in the government’s DNA. In a social media post, Lacson described Duterte’s statement as “sweeping,” adding that corruption may exist across the bureaucracy but should not be used to characterize all public officials.
